organization.name: PrestaShop SA
organization.parent: cyber_Pixel sp. z o.o.; ultimate parent cyber_Folks S.A. (Warsaw Stock Exchange)
organization.notes: Founded 2007. February 18, 2026 acquisition supersedes MBE/Fortidia ownership: cyber_Pixel bought 100% of PrestaShop; ultimate group cyber_Folks is Warsaw-listed. Serena, XAnge and Seventure are historical investors, not current owners after full acquisition.

pricingTiers.name: Classic
pricingTiers.notes: Software license cost is zero; infrastructure, extensions and external services can cost extra.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the current public pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Hosted
pricingTiers.notes: Vendor Hosted bundle, distinct from free Classic source. €24/month annual payment ×12 or €29/month no commitment; VAT excluded.
Current offers page has Classic and Hosted only. Legacy /enterprise URL failed; no current Enterprise offer/quote verified.

moats.claim: Its established merchant/module ecosystem and European commerce specialization create localized implementation and extension advantages.

productReasons.claim: A unified one-page checkout reduces the number of checkout steps merchants need to configure.
Localized payments and multi-currency selling support merchants serving multiple national markets.
Catalog connections to social networks and marketing modules link product merchandising to acquisition channels.

sponsorship.notes: No independent corporate financial sponsor roster established from current project pages. PrestaShop SA is the verified business steward; its cyber_Folks group backing is ownership, not automatically sponsorship.

requirements.notes: PrestaShop 9 docs list PHP 8.1–8.5 depending minor; 8.5 recommended for 9.1. Confirm 9.2 package compatibility; chart reviewed still ends at 9.1.

requirements.condition: MySQL OR MariaDB; recent version recommended
MariaDB OR MySQL; recent version recommended

requirements.notes: cURL, DOM, fileinfo, GD, iconv, intl, JSON, mbstring, OpenSSL, PDO/MySQL, SimpleXML and Zip; allow_url_fopen enabled.

resources.os: Unix/Linux preferred; macOS works; Windows not actively supported
resources.notes: 512M is per-script allocation recommendation; no fixed machine CPU/disk minimum published.

selfHosting.notes: No required Redis, external queue or object-storage server listed for baseline; modules/payment services may add dependencies. Runtime chart limitation explicitly preserved.

oneClickInstall.notes: Official project links downloadable releases and manual/CLI/Docker installation; no current officially linked one-click self-host template verified. Hosted subscription is a vendor service, not represented as a self-host installer.
